# Germany MCP

> 34 read-only MCP servers (172 tools) for German web services — news, weather, transport, open data, finance, housing, sports and more. Every server runs locally with uvx, no API key, no account.

## Servers

- [bundesliga-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/bundesliga-mcp): Bundesliga, 2./3. Liga, DFB-Pokal & DEL via OpenLigaDB (free API, no key): fixtures, live scores, tables, top scorers. (6 tools) — details + Markdown version: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/germany-mcp/#/en/tool/bundesliga-mcp
- [mediathek-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/mediathek-mcp): ARD, ZDF, 3sat, ARTE, Phoenix & more via MediathekViewWeb (free API, no key): search programmes, latest broadcasts, by channel/topic, programme detail. (6 tools) — details + Markdown version: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/germany-mcp/#/en/tool/mediathek-mcp
- [tagesschau-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/tagesschau-mcp): tagesschau.de (ARD) via official RSS feeds (no key): headlines, news by section, regional news for all 16 states, latest videos & full article text. (6 tools) — details + Markdown version: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/germany-mcp/#/en/tool/tagesschau-mcp
- [dwd-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/dwd-mcp): DWD (Deutscher Wetterdienst) via Open-Meteo ICON model (no key): forecasts, current weather, official warnings & pollen. (5 tools) — details + Markdown version: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/germany-mcp/#/en/tool/dwd-mcp
- [autobahn-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/autobahn-mcp): German Autobahn data from the official verkehr.autobahn.de API (no key): roadworks, closures, warnings, truck/car parking and EV charging stations per motorway. (5 tools) — details + Markdown version: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/germany-mcp/#/en/tool/autobahn-mcp
- [dw-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/dw-mcp): Deutsche Welle news in 31 languages from DW's official sitemaps (no key): latest headlines, keyword search, latest articles, full article text and topic pages. (5 tools) — details + Markdown version: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/germany-mcp/#/en/tool/dw-mcp
- [ntv-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/ntv-mcp): n-tv news from its official RSS feeds (no key): latest headlines by section, market news, latest videos, keyword search and full article text. (5 tools) — details + Markdown version: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/germany-mcp/#/en/tool/ntv-mcp
- [dnb-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/dnb-mcp): Deutsche Nationalbibliothek catalogue via its official SRU API (no key): keyword, title and author search, ISBN and DNB-ID lookup. (5 tools) — details + Markdown version: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/germany-mcp/#/en/tool/dnb-mcp
- [govdata-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/govdata-mcp): Germany's national open-data portal govdata.de via its official CKAN API (no key): search 163,000+ datasets, dataset details, publishers, recent datasets and resource details. (5 tools) — details + Markdown version: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/germany-mcp/#/en/tool/govdata-mcp
- [deutschlandfunk-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/deutschlandfunk-mcp): Deutschlandfunk news & radio from its official RSS feeds (no key): rolling news, latest contributions, topic feeds, keyword search, full article text and the live stream link. (6 tools) — details + Markdown version: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/germany-mcp/#/en/tool/deutschlandfunk-mcp
- [duden-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/duden-mcp): Duden dictionary lookup from duden.de (free, no key, no login): word meanings, synonyms, spelling with hyphenation, grammar notes and full verb conjugation. (6 tools) — details + Markdown version: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/germany-mcp/#/en/tool/duden-mcp
- [dictcc-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/dictcc-mcp): dict.cc translations from dict.cc (free, no key, no login): German-English plus 22 more pairs, with word class, gender, usage notes and community votes. (2 tools) — details + Markdown version: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/germany-mcp/#/en/tool/dictcc-mcp
- [bundeswahlleiter-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/bundeswahlleiter-mcp): Official Bundestag election results from bundeswahlleiterin.de (free open data, no key, no login): national results, party results, constituencies and turnout for 2017, 2021 and 2025. (5 tools) — details + Markdown version: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/germany-mcp/#/en/tool/bundeswahlleiter-mcp
- [flixtrain-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/flixtrain-mcp): FlixTrain times & prices from the FlixBus shop search API (free, no key, no login): train-only departures between German cities, with stations, duration, price and seat availability. - [fernsehserien-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/fernsehserien-mcp): German TV series from fernsehserien.de (free, no key, no login): search series, series details, episode guides and upcoming air dates. - [ecb-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/ecb-mcp): European Central Bank data via the official ECB SDMX API (free, no key, no login): euro exchange rates, key ECB interest rates, HICP inflation, M3 money supply and euro-area bond yields. - [feiertage-mcp](https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/feiertage-mcp): Feiertage — German public holidays via feiertage-api.de (free API, no key): holidays by year & state, is-it-a-holiday, next holiday & date ranges. ## Data files

- Full catalog JSON: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/germany-mcp/catalog.json

## Install

- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user <name> -- uvx <package>`
- Any MCP client: add `{"command": "uvx", "args": ["<package>"]}` under `mcpServers` in the client's config.
- All servers at once: clone https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/germany-mcp and open it in Claude Code — `.mcp.json` registers every server.
- Profile builder (pick servers, get a ready config): https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/germany-mcp/#/en/builder
